title: If You Don’t Let The Past Die

scenes.narration: If you don't let the past die, it won't let you live.
scenes.image_query: If you don't let the past die, it won't let you live.

scenes.narration: It stays in your decisions, in what you avoid, in what you accept without asking why.
scenes.image_query: It stays in your decisions, in what you avoid, in what you accept without asking why.

scenes.narration: The past has already taken enough.
scenes.image_query: The past has already taken enough.

scenes.narration: Don't let it take your present.
